data: What is the approximate value of the black dashed line at the length of 8.19 thousands of words on the emergence plot?

The black dashed line represents the English language data in the emergence plot. At the length of 8.19 thousands of words, the black dashed line appears to be approximately at the 0.7 mark on the vertical axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the black dashed line at this point is 0.7.
